input.purpose: Collect short free-form operational values while preserving label, value, helper, validation, loading, disabled, and keyboard behavior.
input.referenceRationale: Adopt the reference field discipline, but express surface, typography, state, density, and motion through Design System foundations and primitives.

anatomy.rule: Owns label, helper, validation, and state relationship.
Names the expected value and remains visible.
Holds typed value, placeholder, prefix, suffix, and focus ring.
Explains format, source, validation, or recovery.
Optional icon or qualifier supports the value without hiding state.
Optional reveal or clear behavior uses the internal Field Action primitive, inherits field density, keeps focus visible, and does not render an autonomous button container.

variants.use: Email capture with native keyboard and autocomplete.
Password capture with optional reveal affordance.
Amount capture with prefix or suffix qualifiers.
Measurement capture with a unit suffix.
Short query capture that filters a current surface.

input.statePrecedence: disabled > loading > error > focus > filled > default

Energy.decision: Use Energy for input surface, border, filled emphasis, error identity, and disabled identity.
Energy.behavior: Energy changes field surface, state, and validation visibly.
Energy.example: Driver ID fields preserve neutral input rhythm and clear error identity.
Energy.test: Verify visual states, focus, and error contrast.
Energy.rejectIf: Energy is only named without changing field behavior.

Voice.decision: Use Voice for label, placeholder, value, helper, and recovery copy.
Voice.behavior: Voice keeps labels and recovery text readable at every density.
Voice.example: Search and wallet fields explain expected value before submission.
Voice.test: Verify label, helper, placeholder, and error text render.
Voice.rejectIf: The field relies on placeholder as the only label.

Frame.decision: Use Frame for field width, stacking, touch target, and grid fit.
Frame.behavior: Frame prevents overflow in mobile stacks and dense filters.
Frame.example: Fleet filters stack on small viewports and align in desktop grids.
Frame.test: Verify full-width, container, and viewport examples do not overflow.
Frame.rejectIf: The field uses fixed width outside its container.

Depth.decision: Use Depth only when the field action opens supporting UI.
Depth.behavior: Depth separates action affordance from the input surface.
Depth.example: Reveal, clear, or lookup affordances remain inside the field hierarchy.
Depth.test: Verify action affordance does not compete with validation.
Depth.rejectIf: Shadow is decorative or replaces state.

Momentum.decision: Use Momentum for focus, loading, and reduced-motion feedback.
Momentum.behavior: Momentum communicates field response without delaying typing.
Momentum.example: Async validation shows progress without losing value.
Momentum.test: Verify reduced motion and loading behavior.
Momentum.rejectIf: Motion blocks input or hides validation.

State.decision: Use State to resolve disabled, loading, error, focus, filled, and default before styling.
State.behavior: State precedence controls styling and interaction.
State.example: Loading beats focus; disabled blocks interaction.
State.rejectIf: State is visual only or contradictory.

Tone.decision: Use Tone to keep field language direct and operational.
Tone.behavior: Tone removes ambiguous placeholder and error copy.
Tone.example: Use 'Enter driver ID' instead of vague instructions.
Tone.test: Verify recovery copy tells what to fix.
Tone.rejectIf: Copy blames the user or hides the fix.

Growth.decision: Use Growth for reusable field behavior across future input variants.
Growth.behavior: Growth keeps input API stable as masks or validation evolve.
Growth.example: Search, ID, amount, and code fields share the same foundation.
Growth.test: Verify props and state model remain portable.
Growth.rejectIf: A product field forks the component for one screen.

Symbol.decision: Use Symbol for prefix, suffix, and action meaning.
Symbol.behavior: Symbols support the value without replacing label or helper.
Symbol.example: Search icon indicates lookup but label still names the input.
Symbol.test: Verify icon-only affordances have accessible names.

Iconography.decision: Use Iconography for leading, trailing, loading, and error affordances.
Iconography.behavior: Icons inherit state and never introduce raw color.
Iconography.example: Error and progress icons follow field state.
Iconography.test: Verify icons inherit currentColor and accessible labels.
Iconography.rejectIf: Icons bypass tokens or duplicate label meaning.

Accessibility.decision: Use Accessibility for visible labels, input semantics, describedby, error announcement, and focus.
Accessibility.behavior: Accessibility makes label, helper, error, disabled, and loading states machine-readable.
Accessibility.example: Validation links error text to the input.
Accessibility.test: Verify label, describedby, aria-invalid, keyboard, and screen reader output.
Accessibility.rejectIf: The field cannot be operated or understood without sight.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label and accessible name source.

props.name: value
props.description: Input value.

props.name: name
props.description: Native input name.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Hint for expected format, never the only label.

props.name: helper
props.description: Alias for helper text in the package factory.

props.name: helperText
props.description: Visible guidance, source, or recovery support.

props.name: error
props.description: Visible validation message associated with the input.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Blocks interaction and explains permission or availability through helper text.

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows async validation or lookup progress.

props.name: required
props.description: Marks value as required in UI and validation.

props.name: density
props.description: Density-owned control scale.

props.name: state
props.description: Explicit visual state for docs and non-interactive previews.

props.name: variant
props.description: Capture role that sets native type and input mode defaults.

props.name: icon
props.description: Optional leading symbol name.

props.name: prefix
props.description: Optional short qualifier before the input; avoid using it as the only currency identifier.

props.name: mono
props.description: Uses the code text role for IDs, plates, card fragments, amounts, and operational codes.

props.name: suffix
props.description: Short non-interactive value qualifier such as MXN, USD, EUR, kg, t, plate, or card.

props.name: type
props.description: Native input type override.

props.name: inputMode
props.description: Native inputmode override for virtual keyboards.

props.name: autocomplete
props.description: Native autocomplete hint.

props.name: align
props.description: Value alignment for text or numeric capture.

props.name: revealable
props.description: Adds a show/hide affordance for password-like values.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with normalized value and display metadata for numeric, currency, and unit capture.

do: Use helper text for format and recovery.
Preserve value during loading and error.
dont: Do not use placeholder as label.
Do not use Select for free-form values.
info: Masks, search suggestions, and multi-field flows become patterns when they sequence decisions.

contextDensityStrategy.layout: full-width stacked fields with visible helper text
form groups and inline filter rows
larger inspector fields and readable remote-entry surfaces

tests: Renders label, value, helper, placeholder, suffix, mono value, and input semantics.
Supports focus, typing, Tab, disabled, loading, and validation.
Associates helper and error text through describedby.
Preserves value across loading and error.
Field Action reveal toggles presentation without changing value or adding autonomous button chrome.
Adapts full-width and responsive layouts without overflow.
agentInstructions: Use Input for short free-form values.
Preserve visible label, helper, value, and recovery state.
Ask before adding masks, suggestions, or multi-field orchestration.
rejectIf: Label is missing or only placeholder exists.
Value is cleared during async validation.
A field-local action uses one-off Icon Button styling instead of Field Action.
Raw color, spacing, radius, or motion bypasses tokens.
